name: compose-dangerous-cap-add
task_triggers: granting Linux capabilities to a container
attack_scenario: CAP_SYS_ADMIN lets a container mount filesystems and manipulate cgroups to break out to the host; CAP_SYS_MODULE loads a malicious kernel module giving full host code execution.
negative_test_hint: add a cap_add entry of "SYS_ADMIN" to the compose service and assert the hardening rejects it or the container runs with all capabilities dropped

exemplar.explanation: cap_add grants Linux capabilities beyond Docker's restricted default set: SYS_ADMIN is near-root, SYS_MODULE loads kernel modules, SYS_PTRACE inspects other processes, and ALL removes the whole capability bound. Dropping all capabilities and adding back only what the workload needs keeps a compromised container confined.
